headline: Embedding geometry and interpretability readouts in biological foundation models
label: Biological Foundation Model Interpretability
summary: Interpretability readouts and embedding geometry of biological foundation models are now validated against known biology across single-cell and bulk data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is treating interpretability readouts and embedding geometry as explicit targets of validation rather than descriptive add-ons. In scGPT, spectral geometry of gene representations is decoded against subcellular localization, PPI strength, and TF-target regulation, and a screen of 141 topological and geometric hypotheses on scGPT and Geneformer embeddings reports shared gene-space structure across both models. Other items extend this logic beyond single-cell models: a contrastive model pre-trained on orthologous exon-intron junctions predicts tissue- and cell-type differential splicing, a dual-path transformer classifies 47 Arabidopsis tissues at 91-92% accuracy, and RNA foundation model embeddings improve cross-cohort endometriosis F1 to 0.83 from 0.68, with CA-IG proposed for gene-level interpretation. What is new is the joint evaluation of representation geometry and biological ground truth, though these studies differ in organism, modality, and validation target.
